text_block_list.text:
A few days after Gentildonna became the first in history
to win consecutive Japan Cups—
I received an invitation from her father.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, it has been a while.
Thank you for accepting my invitation once again.
choice_data_list: No...

text_block_list.text: A second invitation since the start of the New Year in the Classic year... Yet the atmosphere was entirely different. That testing gaze from before was completely gone—
choice_data_list: (If anything, she seems indifferent...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...So, Father.
What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
I will get straight to the point.
Trainer, for you, there is—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
I would like you to resign
as Gentildonna's Trainer.

—The ground beneath my feet
gave way.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
As you know full well,
Gentildonna is an Umamusume of rare, generational talent.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
This girl has the capacity to hold the world in her grasp.
—As the "strongest of all."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
To stand at the top of the world, the assistance
of a top trainer who knows the world is essential.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Someone truly capable, blessed with both deep experience and skill,
who has guided their pupils to the pinnacle of the world time and time again—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
I have already had the candidate watch Gentildonna run,
and they acknowledged my daughter's talent.
They were confident that together, they could lead her to the top.
choice_data_list: …I see you've already gotten things that far sorted out.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: "...Gentildonna has become the umamusume she is today thanks entirely to your dedicated efforts."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
I offer you my deepest respect.
However—this is as far as you go.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna has already attained greatness.
If she aims even higher... she must be guided
by someone who knows what lies beyond.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
All that is left is for you to accept it.
A better path, for the sake of Gentildonna.
choice_data_list: (Gentildonna...)

text_block_list.text: She must have heard about this for the first time today, too. Her expression is unreadable... but first, I need to hear how she feels.
choice_data_list: ...What do you want to do?
...What is your wish?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural to take the best possible means
to achieve one's objective.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—I have always done so.
From the very beginning, all this time.

"—'I need a little time.'
Those were the only words I could barely manage to squeeze out."
choice_data_list: Quit as Gentil's trainer...?

text_block_list.text:
"Speaking it aloud made my head spin.
It was truly a bolt from the blue... yet,
that choice was closing in as reality."

I take pride in having guided her this far.
However, I can understand her father's point of view to some extent... My lack of experience is a fact, after all.
choice_data_list: (I don't want to give up on her... but...)

text_block_list.text:
"A better path for Gentildonna..."
"The best possible means"... Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies.
You weren't reacting at all, so...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right?
You seemed quite stunned, though...
choice_data_list: Everything okay? Did you need something from me?
Are you okay? Did you need me for something?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...
I have a favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind
watching my training?
choice_data_list: Huh... Me? To you?
Huh... I... did that to you?

text_block_list.text:
The unexpected offer caught me by surprise. To her,
Gentildonna was her greatest rival...
To think she would reach out to me, Gentildonna's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...You're probably thinking
that I have no pride."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't afford to worry about appearances.
I... will do whatever it takes to win.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To that person.
To Gentildonna-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the Takarazuka Kinen,
and the other day's Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—She won every single one.
As if it were the most natural thing in the world.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"As a loser, all I could do was just watch...
As if that were only natural."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And yet...
There is no way this should be taken for granted.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
How could I be satisfied?
The day I get used to losing will never come.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will not give up.
Even if my opponent is immense..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to lead myself!
All the way to the very top!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That the only ones worthy of possessing power are those who hunger for it and are prepared to pursue it at any cost.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Seize it.
—The power you seek.

Stirred by Verxina's fighting spirit, my eyes open.
If I refuse to give in... I must seek power by any means necessary, and—
choice_data_list: (I just need to become the "best means"!)
(I just have to become the "best possible means"!)

text_block_list.text:
—Greater power.
I will prove... my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm not asking you to tell me
Ms. Gentile's weaknesses.
I'll find those out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As the one who made Ms. Gentile so strong,
I want to know how you evaluate me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...She, too,
would want me to become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So I believe this arrangement
benefits you as well.
...Will you accept?"
choice_data_list: ...Are you really okay with this?
...You're really sure about this, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: I'm going to learn everything I can from you too!
I'll be learning everything thoroughly from you too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is surpass who I am right now...! Please guide me!
After watching over Verxina's training for a while after that and giving her some advice—

“—I've organized what I need to do from here on out.
First and foremost, I must prove my strength to Gentildonna.”

"A place to prove my worth as a Trainer...
Ultimately, that can only be through victory in a race.
And at the end of the year, there's the perfect race for it."
choice_data_list: I'll come up with the perfect plan for it!

text_block_list.text:
From that day on, past race literature, cutting-edge research,
training data from other Umamusume...
We gathered and studied every single piece of information we could find.
choice_data_list: (Cut the excess thoughts... leave no room for weakness!)

text_block_list.text:
"—I hungered, I sought. Casting aside compromise,
I kept searching for better choices...
To reach beyond her, to a vantage point higher than anyone else—"

Ever since the day I first saw Gentildonna run—
there has only been one thing I desire.
A few days later... Having prepared everything, I called Gentildonna over.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That look in your eyes.
...Have you made up your mind?
choice_data_list: Yeah, will you hear me out?
Yeah, will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Here you go.
choice_data_list: I want you to enter a certain race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
And what race would that be?
choice_data_list: The "Arima Kinen"—

text_block_list.text:
The grand Grand Prix race held at the end of the year.
A race where the top Umamusume representing the entire year compete... the ultimate showdown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Making one last memory...
Is that what this is, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: It's to win you over.
It's so I can win you over.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...So you prepared
the best possible stage for that purpose, then."
choice_data_list: And the greatest opponent, too.
And the best opponent to go with it.

text_block_list.text: It was the night of the day I watched Verxina's training—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Her errand runner, are you?
What is your business?
choice_data_list: How about entering the "Arima Kinen"?
Won't you run in the "Arima Kinen"?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"At present,
I am at rest."
After finishing her second attempt at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, Orfevre announced she would take a brief rest and stepped away from the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm not in the mood.
choice_data_list: This is your chance for revenge!
This is your chance for revenge!

text_block_list.text: "In the Classic Year's Japan Cup, and then the Osaka Hai... Gentildonna is leading the score."
choice_data_list: Are you just going to stay defeated like this?
Are you really okay with staying defeated like this?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Is that cheap provocation a message from your master?
choice_data_list: It's the voices of your people
It's the voices of your people

text_block_list.text:
It was a bet made with complete conviction.
Up until now, Orfevre had shown that she did care about her fans.
choice_data_list: (She'll come around... I know she will!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If you have resolved yourself to that extent...
I shall accept your insolent invitation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Convey this to Gentile.
—Tell her to polish Our throne well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Orfe-san is certainly
an interesting opponent."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “Yet, they have already been defeated. Is there any room left to use your power?”
choice_data_list: I'll get you perfectly adapted to the Nakayama course as well.

text_block_list.text:
She has relatively little experience
with the course at Nakayama Racecourse...
I've thought up numerous countermeasures for it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Is that all?
Then I shall do it myself—"
choice_data_list: Take a look at this.
Look at this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This is...—

What I showed her was the strategy for the Arima Kinen.
In addition to a short-term training regimen, it incorporated a variety of analyses.

—Every single one of them, with greater intensity than ever before.
Leaving no openings, covering every anticipated question, a strategy poured with all the "power" cultivated so far.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Flawless, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You asked me about that before.
You asked me about that before.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what you will do.
I wonder what you will draw strength from..."

"Now is the time to prove it.
The power I possess... is what will
make Gentildonna complete."

"As a Trainer, beyond the realm of the strongest...
I need the power to make whatever she seeks
become a reality, no matter what—"
choice_data_list: I have the power to lift you up!
I have the power to lift you higher!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Your trainer is... me!
Your Trainer is... me!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Fufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Let us see you demonstrate your power to the fullest.
As the Trainer of the 'Strongest.'"
And so, out of nowhere, her entry into the Arima Kinen was officially decided!
